items.headline: Fed decision arrives with markets heavily priced for a 25bp hike
items.summary: Interest-rate futures entered the September 16 FOMC decision with a greater-than-90% probability of a 25bp increase.
items.market_read: The hike itself is largely priced; the marginal USD/rates signal is whether Chair Kevin Warsh validates additional tightening through year-end.

evidence.notes: Reuters source used for gated V0 refresh.

items.headline: Saudi workaround reduces the extreme oil-supply tail
items.summary: Saudi Arabia began offering additional crude via ship-to-ship transfers off Oman after the East-West pipeline attack, while oil prices eased modestly.
items.market_read: Supply remains tight and inflationary, but the tail risk of abruptly losing 4-5% of global supply has eased, slightly reducing the rates impulse and CAD energy tailwind.

lineage.qualifying_gate: energy shock with direct inflation/rates/CAD transmission

evidence.notes: Reuters source used for gated V0 refresh.

items.headline: Australian housing downturn shows the RBA tightening channel biting
items.summary: NSW residential stamp-duty receipts fell 24% year over year in August as transaction volumes fell 18%; Sydney and Melbourne home values are down more than 7% from peak.
items.market_read: The domestic-demand and financial-conditions drag is becoming more visible even as markets price another RBA hike.

lineage.qualifying_gate: direct Australia financial-conditions and growth transmission

evidence.notes: Reuters source used for gated V0 refresh.

items.headline: New Zealand passes India trade agreement
items.summary: New Zealand's parliament approved legislation implementing a trade agreement that eliminates or materially reduces tariffs on about 95% of New Zealand exports to India.
items.market_read: Constructive medium-term export diversification and growth evidence, with limited immediate OCR impact.

evidence.notes: Reuters source used for gated V0 refresh.
